name: tickekette
description: Billetterie multi-collectifs : vente sans survente, liste d'attente, contrôle hors ligne.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
